generation.artery_basis: one bidirectional centreline per artwork corridor
generation.repeated_path_basis: analytical reinforcement only; no duplicate geometry
generation.individual_trace_basis: directed evidence retained in artery metadata
generation.brightness_and_glow_metric: edge Count/Weight for arteries; AverageDwell for branches
generation.growth_method: one turn-limited Perlin centreline plus local recursive growth
generation.branching_method: parent-child trees taper and shorten by generation, normally ending freely
generation.curvature_method: multi-frequency seeded Perlin attractors, smooth heading interpolation, and bounded angular change
generation.animation_order: arteries initiate first; cumulative visitors reveal persistent local trees
generation.spatial_memory: completed vessels remain visible as cumulative spatial memory
generation.dendrite_basis: AverageDwell controls density; VisitCount controls node roots; DeepVisitCount controls depth, length, and lifetime
generation.dendrite_geometry: seeded cubic Bezier branches with explicit parent-child topology
generation.local_density_control: nearby fine-vessel occupancy suppresses splitting; empty cells encourage exploration
generation.colour_method: monochrome white-grey; data is encoded by width, luminance, density, and complexity
generation.visitor_stages: each curve records the cumulative visitor count that activates it
